## Which process document do you want to update?
<new document>

## Summary of New Content
Create a new README.md file in the `docs/` folder that serves as a central index for all OctoAcme Project Management Process Documents. The README will include:
- A brief overview of OctoAcme's project management approach and core principles
- A complete table of contents with links to all eight existing process documents
- Quick reference to the core roles and responsibilities
- Information on how to use these docs and contribute to them

## Why is this update needed?
This README addresses a critical gap in discoverability and onboarding. Currently, team members and new contributors must navigate the docs folder without a clear guide. A centralized README will:
- Reduce onboarding time for new team members
- Provide a single entry point to understand OctoAcme's complete project management lifecycle
- Improve navigation and cross-linking between related processes
- Support the stated goal of "giving all team members equal access to processes, decisions, and rationale"
- Enable contributors to understand where to find specific guidance within the process documentation

## Suggested Content
The README should include:

### Overview Section
Brief summary of OctoAcme's project management approach, core principles (customer-first, iterative delivery, clear ownership, data-informed decisions, psychological safety), and key roles (PM, PdM, Developers, QA/Testing, Stakeholders).

### Complete Documentation Index
- [OctoAcme Project Management Overview](./octoacme-project-management-overview.md) - Concise introduction to how OctoAcme runs projects
- [OctoAcme Project Initiation Guide](./octoacme-project-initiation.md) - Validate and authorize work, align stakeholders
- [OctoAcme Project Planning](./octoacme-project-planning.md) - Turn approved initiatives into actionable plans
- [OctoAcme Execution & Tracking](./octoacme-execution-and-tracking.md) - Day-to-day execution and progress tracking
- [OctoAcme Risk Management & Communication](./octoacme-risks-and-communication.md) - Identify, manage, and communicate risks
- [OctoAcme Release & Deployment Guide](./octoacme-release-and-deployment.md) - Standardize releases to production
- [OctoAcme Retrospective & Continuous Improvement](./octoacme-retrospective-and-continuous-improvement.md) - Capture learnings and improvements
- [OctoAcme Roles and Personas](./octoacme-roles-and-personas.md) - Define typical roles and responsibilities

### Quick Start Section
Guidance on which document to reference for different scenarios (starting a new project, planning execution, managing risks, etc.)
